build_camera_sensors: build camera sensors from MJCF root and CameraConfig mapping for a MuJoCo simulation
build_camera_pose_sensors: build camera pose sensors without images from MJCF root and camera configurations
create_pinhole_intrinsics: create a pinhole camera intrinsic matrix given image shape and vertical field of view
create_sensor_bundle: create a paired CameraPoseSensor and CameraImageSensor bundle from an MJCF camera element
configure_camera_config: configure a CameraConfig dataclass with width, height, fovy, rgb, depth, and shadow settings
